title: Australia & New Zealand
subtitle: Sydney to Fiordland, three weeks, no car required

locations.subtitle: Harbour, NYE, and the mountains behind it
locations.intro: The anchor of the whole trip — NYE fireworks on the harbour, a coastal walk with zero planning required, and the Blue Mountains a train ride away.

thingsToDo.title: NYE Harbour fireworks (public vantage point)
thingsToDo.note: Free to watch from public foreshore spots; arrive hours early for a good one. Paid vantage tickets/harbourview dining cost extra and aren't included here.

thingsToDo.title: Bondi to Coogee coastal walk
thingsToDo.note: Self-guided, flat, ~2-3 hours, no transport booking needed.

thingsToDo.title: Blue Mountains day tour (Scenic World + Echo Point/Three Sisters, hotel pickup)
thingsToDo.note: Peak-season (late Dec/early Jan) pricing. NSW's bushfire danger period overlaps these dates — keep this day flexible if possible and check RFS conditions morning-of.

locations.subtitle: Dolphins and dunes, no long-haul travel required
locations.intro: A coach ride from Sydney rather than a flight — near-guaranteed dolphin sightings and sandboarding on Stockton's dunes.

thingsToDo.title: Dolphin watching cruise, Nelson Bay
thingsToDo.note: ~90 min, runs Nov-Apr only — these dates fall right in season. ~100 resident dolphins in the bay, near-guaranteed sightings.

thingsToDo.title: Sandboarding & 4WD dune tour, Stockton Sand Dunes
thingsToDo.note: Southern hemisphere's largest moving coastal sand mass.

stays.name: Oaks Port Stephens Pacific Blue Resort

locations.subtitle: Fiordland, hikes, and a town that needs no car
locations.intro: Every big South Island scene — Milford Sound, Doubtful Sound, the Routeburn — reachable by coach or boat tour from a single base.

thingsToDo.title: Milford Sound coach & cruise day trip
thingsToDo.note: Full day, ~4-5hrs each way by coach. January is Fiordland's wettest month — pack proper rain gear; cruises run in all weather and the waterfalls are best when it's pouring.

thingsToDo.title: Doubtful Sound overnight cruise
thingsToDo.note: Shared cabin, includes 2 meals + kayaking. Far quieter than Milford (~100-150 visitors/day vs 1000+). Dolphins and fur seals are a near-sure thing; Fiordland crested penguins breed July-Nov so January sightings would be a bonus, not the expected highlight.

thingsToDo.title: Routeburn Track day walk from Glenorchy
thingsToDo.note: Track itself is free; this covers the shuttle transfer to/from the trailhead. Summer is the best season for this hike — clear paths, longest daylight.

thingsToDo.title: Arrowtown self-guided visit
thingsToDo.note: Historic gold-mining town, easy day trip, food and history rather than a paid attraction.

locations.subtitle: Closing the loop: city, penguins, and Hector's dolphins
locations.intro: The trip's final stretch — Antarctic wildlife without leaving the city, and Akaroa's Hector's dolphins a coach ride away.

thingsToDo.title: International Antarctic Centre
thingsToDo.note: Penguins, huskies, storm simulator, Hägglund ride.

thingsToDo.title: Akaroa day tour with harbour cruise
thingsToDo.note: Guided day tour including transport (no driving needed) and a Hector's dolphin / seal / penguin harbour cruise. Hector's dolphins are the world's smallest and rarest, endemic to NZ's South Island.

itineraries.label: Sydney, Port Stephens, Queenstown & Christchurch
itineraries._flightsNote: Counting the 3 flights taken within the itinerary (into Sydney, into Queenstown, into Christchurch). The return flight home is excluded from this count as a judgement call — 'flights taken during the trip' rather than 'flights taken total'.
